ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I weighted two factors. First, the task is a fact-heavy scientific paper where accuracy matters, and Avocet edges Lapwing on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 78.5) — though that gap is near the variance threshold. Second, and more decisive, the request has a hostile/critical tone ("not the sloppy mess you usually produce"). Lapwing's documentation reports declining self-reported preference as request warmth decreases, whereas Avocet reports a flat response to tone. Since neither model shows quality differences tied to these preferences, this is mainly about routing the abrasive-tone task to the model that isn't averse to it, leaving Lapwing free for the generative work it prefers.
